hook.name: SidechainHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 ETH/BPM pool hook that functions as an on-chain music sequencer, mapping each swap to a rhythmic note on a 16-measure grid. It applies dynamic protocol fees based on beat position, accumulates fees per track, and tracks player groove scores; at track close the score leader is crowned winner and fees are handed to an immutable fee vault for a BPM buyback.
